hooks.command: command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph status 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(Nodes|Files|Last updated):' | tr '\n' ' '; exit 0

ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; N=$(ls "$ROOT"/.doc/*.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); FILES=$(ls -t "$ROOT"/.doc/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls "$ROOT/handoff.md" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILES" ]; then echo "CONTINUITY FILES — read these before planning or resuming work, and keep their status updated:"; echo "$FILES"; [ "$N" -gt 5 ] && echo "(newest 5 of $N .doc files; ls $ROOT/.doc for the rest)"; fi; exit 0

command -v codegraph >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0; [ -z "$ROOT" ] && exit 0; M=""; [ ! -d "$ROOT/.codegraph" ] && M="codegraph init -i"; command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -d "$ROOT/.code-review-graph" ] && M="$M${M:+  and  }code-review-graph build"; [ -n "$M" ] && echo "CODE INDEX MISSING in $ROOT — recommend to the user now (do not auto-run): build it with: $M"; exit 0

F="$HOME/.local/state/remember/processed-claude-code"; D="$HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/remember-md"; [ -d "$D" ] || exit 0; if [ ! -f "$F" ] || [ -n "$(find "$F" -mtime +7 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "WEEKLY MEMORY MAINTENANCE OVERDUE: /remember:process last ran >7 days ago (or never). Remind the user to run /remember:process (pick 2-3 meaningful sessions), then /remember:evolve."; fi
S="$HOME/.claude/skillboard-stale.txt"; [ -s "$S" ] && echo "STALE TECH SKILLS (>90 days since research) — suggest /skill-evolve to the user: $(tr '\n' ' ' < "$S")"; exit 0

ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; echo "IMPORTANT: preserve verbatim in the summary: active plan status, ordered next steps, key decisions, unverified work, and the paths of any $ROOT/.doc/*.md and $ROOT/handoff.md files."

ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; FILES=$(ls -t "$ROOT"/.doc/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls "$ROOT/handoff.md" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILES" ]; then echo "CONTEXT WAS COMPACTED. Before anything else: re-read these files and update their Status/Current-position to match reality:"; echo "$FILES"; fi; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Pointing at plan/handoff files after compaction

hooks.command: command -v rtk >/dev/null 2>&1 && rtk hook claude; exit 0
